guide.title: The Ultimate Vibration Plate Buying Guide 2025
guide.introduction: Discover the best vibration plate for your lifestyle. Whether it's for your home office, small apartment, or daily fitnessroutine — here's everything you should know before buying.

keyFeatures.title: What to Look For: Key Buying Criteria

motorPower.title: Size & Portability
motorPower.description: Make sure the vibration plate fits under your desk.Lightweight models with foldable designs and wheels offerthe most flexibility for small spaces.

inclineSettings.title: Speed & Incline Options
inclineSettings.description: Most pads max out between 2–4 mph. For more intensesessions, look for models with adjustable incline — itboosts calorie burn and workout versatility.

beltSize.title: Belt Size & Deck Length
beltSize.description: Aim for a belt wide and long enough for a natural stride —especially important if you're taller or vibration at a fast pace.

weightCapacity.title: Weight Capacity & Build Quality
weightCapacity.description: A higher weight rating typically means a more durable,strengthened frame — something to prioritise forlong-term use.

display.title: Noise Level
display.description: If you plan to Vibration while working or during video calls,choose a pad with a motor rated under 60 dB — quietoperation is key.

foldability.title: Ease of Use & Controls
foldability.description: Look for user-friendly interfaces — remote control, LEDdisplay, or smart app integration help make workoutsseamless and enjoyable.

beginners.title: For Beginners
beginners.description: Start with a lightweight, foldable vibration plate with simple controls and a max speed around 3–4 km/h. Focus on comfort and ease of use rather than advanced features.

runners.title: For Fast Vibration
runners.description: Opt for a longer belt (at least 45 inches / 115 cm) and slightly higher top speed (up to 6–7 km/h) for natural strides without feeling restricted.

seniors.title: For Seniors
seniors.description: Choose a vibration plate with strong cushioning, quiet operation, and a stable deck. Look for safety features like auto-stop, non-slip belts, and handrail compatibility.

homeGym.title: For Small Apartments
homeGym.description: Go for an ultra-slim, foldable design with transport wheels so it can easily slide under a bed or sofa after use.
